DISNEYLAND1967: A First-Person Walk

Sunday, August 13, 1967. Pirates of the Caribbean opened this spring, New Orleans Square is brand new, New Tomorrowland has been open since July 18, and you have $50.00 in your pocket.

Walk Town Square and Main Street, step inside the shops, wander the Central Plaza, and queue for Pirates of the Caribbean. Everything is drawn in real time by a Wolfenstein-style grid raycaster.

Move W A S D / arrows - look with the mouse (click the view) - Use / enter / sit E or Space - Items I - Map M - Photo P - Menu Esc. Carry up to two things, one in each hand: touch a hand (or press Z / X) to take a bite, sip, read the map or take a photo. With a game controller: left stick walks, right stick looks, A uses, X / Y use the hands, RB / L3 runs, LB photo, Start menu, B closes. On a phone: left stick, drag to look, round button to use.

Layout is a compressed, approximate reconstruction from published descriptions and photographs. No blueprints are public. Locomotive and omnibus art: “Disneyland Resort Locomotive” (skfb.ly/6WUGw) and “Disneyland Resort Double Decker Bus” (skfb.ly/6Rr7y) by Kastle, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Entrance turnstiles and Esplanade trash cans adapted from “Disneyland Turnstile” (skfb.ly/6WSP8) and “Disneyland Resort Entrance Plaza Trash Can” (skfb.ly/6WY6w) by Kastle, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (modern designs, simplified). Benches: “Mainstreet USA Bench” (skfb.ly/6UsTX) by Kastle, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Tobacco Shop figure: “Disneyland Main Street Wooden Indian” (skfb.ly/os8qX) by clintonnichols, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (simplified). Free, non-commercial fan project.
